subject: statistics: avoid using infoschema when to init stats (#54514)
summary: Diff removes `infoschema` dependency from `InitStatsLite` by initializing stats meta/histogram existence without table metadata, refactors `ColAndIdxExistenceMap` and adjusts sync/async stats loading paths to fetch column/index metadata on-demand from current `InfoSchema`, and wires the new signatures through domain/handle. Follow-up commits on `pingcap/master` later corrected/adjusted edge behaviors introduced here, so there is no remaining Blocker/High issue to report.
